blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police-Anti-Cybercrime Group (PNP-ACG) urged the public to remain vigilant when transacting with online sellers, particularly as shoppers increasingly turn to online platforms to purchase gifts for the upcoming holiday season.
